// diagnostic

E0368

This fence is empty.

What

This fence is empty.

Why

A fenced statement needs at least one entry to expand.

Fix

Write one or more entries between `@[` and `]@`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0368: tests/ui/fenced_name_empty.stderr.

Error [E0368]: this fence is empty
  --> tests/ui/fenced_name_empty.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     @[ ]@ :: 1
    |     ^^
 Why: a fenced statement needs at least one entry to expand
 Fix: write one or more entries between `@[` and `]@`
